column1: # This CSV file is the single source of truth for all machines managed by
# Metal3.  Run `./generate.sh` after editing to regenerate the Kubernetes
#   vmid        — Proxmox VM ID (for Proxmox VMs) or "physical" for bare metal
#   mac         — Boot MAC address (must match the VM/NUC network config)
#   accepted    — Whether Metal3 should manage this host (true/false)
#   online      — Whether the host should be powered on (true/false)
#   Proxmox VMs share a single Secret (proxmox-bmc) since they all use the
#   same proxmox-redfish daemon with the same Proxmox credentials.
#   Physical NUCs use per-host Secrets (see bmc_credentials column).
#   Values: "proxmox-shared" or a custom secret name.
# bmc_credentials — Name of the Kubernetes Secret with BMC credentials
#   Use "proxmox-shared" for all Proxmox VMs (shared Secret)
#   Use "<name>-bmc" for physical NUCs with unique credentials
# Physical NUCs — no BMC (manual USB boot provisioning).
# Replace placeholder MACs with real ones when NUCs arrive.
# bmc_address=none and bmc_credentials=none → generate.sh skips BMC section.
